findings.description: The policy grants unrestricted ec2:*, s3:*, lambda:*, and cloudwatch:* permissions against every resource. Attached to the svc_deploy IAM user, this violates least privilege and enables broad modification and data-access capabilities across these services, including actions that can facilitate privilege escalation or data exfiltration.

The output exposes the IAM access key encrypted secret. Terraform outputs are commonly persisted in state and may be displayed or consumed by users and automation; without a sensitive designation, this credential material can be exposed to unauthorized readers of outputs or state.
